title: H5b fix round 4: the review re-spawn re-reads the task under the bus lock and only re-spawns when it is still queued, and skips stale tasks like the execute dispatch loop does (review T-0403)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain ec54196, 3164bed, f7df4d7, a553af1 and f25d62f (T-0363, T-0393, T-0396, T-0401) in git log; never drop or amend them.
Review T-0403 on T-0401, both findings to address:
1. (high) orchestrator/daemon.py:584 the re-spawn loop stamps respawned_at and calls spawn_async(spawn.run_worker, id) under bus.locked() without re-reading the task; the outer bus.read(status queued) snapshot can be stale, so a slow (not dead) original spawn thread that claims in that window is followed by a second run_worker for the same task, and both race on the worktree and both post results. Fix: inside the lock, re-read the task with bus.get and proceed only when status is still queued and respawned_at is still absent for the current requeue; otherwise skip. Test: tests/test_daemon.py::test_respawn_skips_task_claimed_between_snapshot_and_lock (patch bus.get to return a running task on the locked re-read; no spawn, no stamp).
2. (low) orchestrator/daemon.py:563 the re-spawn loop never checks stale(task) unlike the execute dispatch loop; add the same skip so reviews of a done or superseded goal are never re-spawned. Test: tests/test_daemon.py::test_respawn_skips_stale_review.
Keep the T-0363, T-0393, T-0396 and T-0401 tests green. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows f25d62f, a553af1, f7df4d7, 3164bed and ec54196 below your commit
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
